title.value: Build a newsletter performance dashboard without coding

introduction.value: A non-coding media operator had Claude Code build a dashboard tracking newsletter performance across a network in about 30 minutes; a solo CFO built an expense system.

method.value: The author, who says they don't write code, described in plain English a dashboard for tracking newsletter performance across their whole network. Claude Code, run from the terminal, built a working tool from that text description. The article doesn't say what data sources it connected to or how the author checked the result. A separate solo CFO reportedly built an expense system.

outcome.value: The author says the dashboard existed about 30 minutes after they described it, replacing work they used to pay contractors $2,000-5,000 for. The CFO's build is secondhand, and the full how-to is paywalled.

notes.value: The dashboard details are thin and the step-by-step guide sits behind a paywall. The cost and time figures are the author's own claims, with no build specifics.
